name: Meowstic

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.desc: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.desc: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.desc: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.

flavor: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

forms.name: Meowstic (F)

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.desc: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.desc: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

forms.flavor: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

forms.name: Mega Meowstic

abilities.name: Split Psyche
abilities.desc: The user's mind is split into two, giving priority to status moves and raises special attack when it's stats are lowered.
